# About Urban Craft & Co.

> Urban Craft & Co. is a premier corporate gifting and custom executive merchandise studio based in Sadar Bazar, Delhi NCR, India.

## Our Heritage & Craftsmanship

Founded with a passion for elevated corporate gifting, Urban Craft & Co. combines traditional artisan craftsmanship with modern enterprise fulfillment. We specialize in creating high-impact executive gift sets, personalized onboarding packages, handcrafted leather merchandise, and premium drinkware tailored for leading organizations across India and worldwide.

## Key Capabilities

- **Artisan Production:** In-house laser engraving, UV printing, precision screen printing, and debossing.
- **Corporate Curation:** Themed 2-in-1, 3-in-1, 4-in-1, 5-in-1, 6-in-1, and 7-in-1 executive gift sets.
- **Enterprise Onboarding:** Custom employee welcome kits delivered with customized packaging and personalized greeting cards.
- **Bulk Logistics:** Nationwide express shipping across 19,000+ pin codes in India with dedicated account management.
- **Low MOQs:** Low minimum order quantities starting from 25–50 units for personalized merchandise.
